column2: 8.  The  Depositary  shall  promptly  notify  all  signatories  and  States
each  signature  of  this  Convention  and  date  thereof;
each  deposit  of  an  instrument  of  ratification,  acceptance,
approval  or  accession  and  date  thereof;
the  date  of  entry  into  force  of  this  Convention;
the date of the coming into force of any revision of the limits
of  liability  established  under  this  Convention;
